notes.title: Development Update #2: Official Teaser Trailer
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012983/5d44616bd25e37e518860fe3c77570291b55f9f8.png

We’re back — and we’ve reached 200+ wishlists!

After a short pause in updates, it’s time to share some exciting news.

First of all, thank you to everyone who has shown interest in Rise of the Bugs. We’ve officially crossed the 200 wishlist milestone, which is a huge step forward for this project. As a solo developer, your support means a lot and gives this strange little world of mutant roaches a real shot at life.

Today also marks the release of our official teaser trailer. This is the first full look at the atmosphere, pacing, and ideas behind the game. Every pixel and line of code has been carefully crafted — and while there’s still work to do, I’m proud to finally show what Rise of the Bugs is becoming.

Watch the teaser on Steam page or YouTube: https://youtu.be/TA0Km2YlX1A?si=fsfVI07XSe7SpHct

What’s next?
We’re actively moving toward releasing a playable demo version of Rise of the Bugs as part of one of this year’s upcoming Steam festivals. The goal is to give players a hands-on experience with the game’s core mechanics, characters, and atmosphere — and to gather early feedback from the community. Development is progressing steadily, and we're focusing on polishing the first levels to make sure the demo reflects the vision and quality we’re aiming for in the full release.

Thanks again for your support. Feel free to leave your thoughts or questions in the comments — I’m always reading.

—
Xauxe Games
Developer of Rise of the Bugs

notes.title: Development Update #1: What’s New in Rise of the Bugs?
notes.notes:
Development Update #1: What’s New in Rise of the Bugs?

Hello everyone! This is Xauxe Games, and I'm excited to share the progress on our 2D pixel platformer! Not many people know, but the game is being developed by a single person. Today, I'll talk about what’s already done, what I plan to work on next, and the goals set for the release of the demo version of the game.

🚀 What’s Already Done?

Several key elements that form the foundation of the gameplay have already been implemented:

- Character-switching mechanics: One of the game's main features is the ability to switch between different types of bugs. Currently, some characters have been animated and added. 
- Initial levels are complete: These levels introduce you to the basics of controls, the storyline, and the core mechanics. You’ll also meet your first enemies and experience the damage system and checkpoints. 
- Enemies: Several types of enemies have been animated and added to the game. 
- The character upgrade book is implemented. 
- Testing: All current levels have been tested and are working without errors.

🔨 What Will Be in the Demo?

We are moving towards releasing a short but rich demo version, which will include several levels. The demo will introduce you to the game's core mechanics and character abilities.

- Limited character access: The demo will allow you to try out two bugs characters with different abilities. The full collection of characters can be unlocked as you progress in the full game after its release. 
- Additional enemies and bosses: In the demo, you’ll encounter new enemies. They won’t pose a huge threat but will help demonstrate the gameplay differences between various bug types. 
- Gameplay variety: Destructible objects and puzzles will be present in the levels. 
- Sound design: We’re working on sound effects and background music. 
- Main menu and game settings. 
- Testing and feedback: Your feedback is incredibly important to me! I’m actively testing the game, and once the demo is ready, I’ll invite you to give it a try. Feel free to join our community for feedback, suggestions, and chatting with other players in our Discord.

Thank you for following the development process! We’re creating with passion to bring this game to life, and I hope you’ll enjoy what I’m working on for you. Stay tuned for more updates, because there’s a lot of exciting things ahead!

Best regards,
Xauxe Games
